blocks.text: Weapons of Mass Destruction for the ignorant. Insurance for the wise.

Spot Market: You pay ₹1 Crore and buy the flat. Simple.
Option Market: You pay a Token Amount (Premium) of ₹1 Lakh to "book" the flat price at ₹1 Cr for 3 months.
- If price goes to ₹1.5 Cr: You exercise your right. Profit!
- If price drops to ₹80L: You walk away. You only lose the ₹1 Lakh token.
blocks.title: 🏠 Buying a Flat vs Buying an Option

blocks.text: Call Option (CE): Betting the market will go UP.
Put Option (PE): Betting the market will go DOWN (Insurance).
Most retailers buy Puts to gamble on crashes. Institutions buy Puts to protect their multi-crore portfolios.
An Option contract is like an Ice Cream cone. It melts every second.
This melting is called Time Decay (Theta). If the market stays flat, the Option Buyer LOSES money because the time ran out.

Retailers BUY options (Lottery tickets). Institutions SELL options (The Casino).
Why? Because 66% of the time, markets are sideways. In sideways markets, Option Buyers lose 100% of their premium due to Theta Decay. Option Sellers keep it.
Verdict: Buying options is playing against the House. Selling options IS the House.
